paragraphs.text: You are beginning to get your bearings in Emberhead. Would you like to explore some more?
You may choose another option from those below. Do not repeat a previous choice. Once you have tried four options (or before that, if you are ready to move on), go to 3.
–Ask about transport at the local general store: go to 16.
–Seek out the village hall: go to 84.
–Walk down to the lower level and check out the eastern road: go to 115.
–Examine the large metal structure: go to 57.
–Look for local people with their own transport needs: go to 96.
